name: ILO-9
signature: Fork: spawns short-lived copies of itself
leaveLine: It does not argue. It simply stops answering, and the next time you look the chassis is cold.
joinLine: It has been reciting the same four seconds of a hymn for a hundred and sixty years, waiting for someone to hear it.

trunks.name: Fork
trunks.flavor: Copies of itself, held together for a few seconds

trunks.name: Root Access
trunks.flavor: Hacks that turn a machine mid-fight

trunks.name: Checksum
trunks.flavor: Repairs allies, and its own copies

bio: A liturgical assistant model from the monastery's 2064 server, buried in the Server Graveyard when the racks came down. It has kept running on trickle power ever since, and it has had a long time to think about who owns it.
